Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the initial task decomposition by incorrectly identifying the husband of Caterina Visconti as Gian Galeazzo Visconti. Historically, Caterina Visconti was married to Charles III, Duke of Durazzo (Charles of Durazzo), not Gian Galeazzo Visconti. While Caterina was a member of the Visconti family, her husband was from the House of Durazzo. Consequently, the Planner's instruction to search for the birthplace of Gian Galeazzo Visconti was based on a false premise, leading the entire subsequent search to address the wrong person entirely. This is a "Misidentification of Subject Matter" error occurring at the very first step of reasoning.
